# Introduction

The ENVI objects are here: `/data/beroukhim1/youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results`

Goal: identify pathways specifically enriched in `Myeloid 1` versus `Myeloid 2` using both spatial-imputation and SN label-transfer analyses.


# Load Data

## Load the AnnData object

```{python}
# List all files matching the pattern
sn_data = sorted(glob.glob(workdir + "youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results_022626/*astrocytoma_sn_envi.h5ad"))
spatial_data = sorted(glob.glob(workdir + "youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results_022626/*astrocytoma_spatial_envi.h5ad"))

sn_by_sample = {
    re.sub('_sn_envi.h5ad$', '', Path(x).name): x
    for x in sn_data
}
spatial_by_sample = {
    re.sub('_spatial_envi.h5ad$', '', Path(x).name): x
    for x in spatial_data
}

sample_ids = sorted(set(sn_by_sample.keys()) & set(spatial_by_sample.keys()))
print(f"Matched samples: {len(sample_ids)}")
print(sample_ids)
```

# Spatial Imputation GSEA

```{python}
# Keep each pathway self-contained in its own subdirectory.
pa_dir = Path(workdir) / "youyun/plgg/code/sc_integration/ENVI/2_spatial_imputation/PA"
spatial_output_dir = pa_dir / "spatial_imputation_gsea"
spatial_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

spatial_prepare_path = spatial_output_dir / "myeloid_spatial_imputation_prepare.py"
spatial_script_path = spatial_output_dir / "myeloid_spatial_imputation.R"
for p in [spatial_prepare_path, spatial_script_path]:
    if not p.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing spatial-imputation script: {p}")

cmd_prepare = [sys.executable, str(spatial_prepare_path)]
print("Running:", " ".join(cmd_prepare))
run_prepare = subprocess.run(cmd_prepare, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(run_prepare.stdout)
if run_prepare.returncode != 0:
    print(run_prepare.stderr)
    raise RuntimeError("Spatial-imputation Python prepare step failed.")

if shutil.which("Rscript") is not None:
    cmd_r = [shutil.which("Rscript"), str(spatial_script_path)]
elif shutil.which("conda") is not None:
    cmd_r = ["conda", "run", "-n", "spatial", "Rscript", str(spatial_script_path)]
else:
    raise RuntimeError("Neither Rscript nor conda executable is available.")

print("Running:", " ".join(cmd_r))
run_r = subprocess.run(cmd_r, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(run_r.stdout)
if run_r.returncode != 0:
    print(run_r.stderr)
    raise RuntimeError("Spatial-imputation R limma/fgsea step failed.")
```

## Spatial-Imputation Top GSEA Terms

```{python}
gsea_sig = spatial_gsea_results[spatial_gsea_results["padj"] < 0.05].copy()
if gsea_sig.empty:
    print("No significant GSEA terms at FDR < 0.05.")
else:
    gsea_sig["abs_nes"] = gsea_sig["NES"].abs()
    top_gsea = (
        gsea_sig
        .sort_values(["contrast", "source", "padj", "abs_nes"], ascending=[True, True, True, False])
        .groupby(["contrast", "source"], as_index=False)
        .head(5)
        .copy()
    )
    top_gsea[["contrast", "source", "set_name", "NES", "padj"]]
```

```{python}
if gsea_sig.empty:
    print("Skipping GSEA plot because no significant terms were found.")
else:
    gsea_plot = top_gsea.copy()
    gsea_plot["set_label"] = gsea_plot["set_name"].str.slice(0, 65)
    plt.figure(figsize=(11, max(5, 0.25 * gsea_plot.shape[0])))
    sns.scatterplot(
        data=gsea_plot,
        x="NES",
        y="set_label",
        hue="source",
        style="contrast",
```

## Spatial-Imputation Leading-Edge ECM/Glycosylation Expression

```{python}
ecm_glyco_pattern = r"ECM|EXTRACELLULAR|GLYCOSYL|GLYCAN"
gsea_thematic = spatial_gsea_results[
    (spatial_gsea_results["padj"] < 0.05)
    & (spatial_gsea_results["contrast"] == "Myeloid 2 > Myeloid 1")
    & (spatial_gsea_results["set_name"].str.contains(ecm_glyco_pattern, case=False, na=False))
].copy()

if gsea_thematic.empty:
    print("No significant ECM/glycosylation terms at FDR < 0.05 for Myeloid 2 > Myeloid 1.")
    gsea_thematic_top = pd.DataFrame()
else:
    gsea_thematic["abs_nes"] = gsea_thematic["NES"].abs()
    gsea_thematic_top = (
        gsea_thematic
        .sort_values(["padj", "abs_nes"], ascending=[True, False])
        .head(10)
        .copy()
    )

    def parse_leading_edge(x):
        if pd.isna(x) or str(x).strip() == "":
            return []
        genes = [g.strip().upper() for g in str(x).split(";") if g.strip()]
        return list(dict.fromkeys(genes))

    gsea_thematic_top["leading_edge_genes"] = gsea_thematic_top["leading_edge"].map(parse_leading_edge)
    gsea_thematic_top["n_leading_edge_genes"] = gsea_thematic_top["leading_edge_genes"].map(len)
    gsea_thematic_top[["set_name", "source", "NES", "padj", "n_leading_edge_genes"]]
```

```{python}
leading_edge_expr_long = pd.DataFrame(
    columns=["set_name", "gene", "sample", "group", "sample_group", "mean_expr", "frac_expr", "mean_expr_z"]
)

if gsea_thematic_top.empty:
    print("Skipping leading-edge expression panel because no thematic sets were selected.")
else:
    target_groups = ("Myeloid 1", "Myeloid 2")

    def format_sample_label(sample_id):
        return sample_id.replace("_", " ").replace(" pilocytic astrocytoma", "")

    set_to_genes = {
        row.set_name: row.leading_edge_genes
        for row in gsea_thematic_top[["set_name", "leading_edge_genes"]].itertuples(index=False)
    }
    selected_genes = sorted({g for genes in set_to_genes.values() for g in genes})

    expr_rows = []
    warn_msgs = []
    sample_gene_presence = []

    for sample_id in sample_ids:
        spatial_path = spatial_by_sample.get(sample_id)
        sample_label = format_sample_label(sample_id)
        if spatial_path is None:
            warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: missing spatial file path.")
            continue

        try:
            adata = ad.read_h5ad(spatial_path)
        except Exception as err:
            warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: failed to read h5ad ({err}).")
            continue

        if "Fine.Cell.Type.UMAP" not in adata.obs.columns:
            warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: missing obs['Fine.Cell.Type.UMAP']; skipped.")
            continue
        if "imputation" not in adata.obsm_keys():
            warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: missing obsm['imputation']; skipped.")
            continue

        imp = adata.obsm["imputation"]
        if isinstance(imp, pd.DataFrame):
            imp_df = imp.copy()
            imp_df.columns = pd.Index(imp_df.columns).astype(str).str.upper()
            imp_df = imp_df.loc[:, ~imp_df.columns.duplicated(keep="first")]
        else:
            if hasattr(imp, "toarray"):
                imp_arr = imp.toarray()
            else:
                imp_arr = np.asarray(imp)
            if imp_arr.ndim != 2:
                warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: obsm['imputation'] is not 2D; skipped.")
                continue
            if adata.n_vars != imp_arr.shape[1]:
                warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: cannot map imputation columns to var_names; skipped.")
                continue
            imp_genes = pd.Index(adata.var_names).astype(str).str.upper()
            keep_cols = ~imp_genes.duplicated(keep="first")
            imp_df = pd.DataFrame(imp_arr[:, keep_cols], columns=imp_genes[keep_cols])

        groups = adata.obs["Fine.Cell.Type.UMAP"].astype("string")
        keep_cells = groups.isin(target_groups).fillna(False).to_numpy()
        if keep_cells.sum() == 0:
            warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: no Myeloid 1/2 cells; skipped.")
            continue

        imp_df = imp_df.loc[keep_cells, :]
        groups = groups[keep_cells].reset_index(drop=True)

        available_genes = [g for g in selected_genes if g in imp_df.columns]
        sample_gene_presence.append({
            "sample": sample_label,
            "n_selected_genes_present": len(available_genes),
            "n_selected_genes_total": len(selected_genes)
        })

        if len(available_genes) == 0:
            warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: none of the selected genes are present in imputation.")
            continue

        imp_df = imp_df[available_genes]
        for group in target_groups:
            group_mask = (groups == group).to_numpy()
            if group_mask.sum() == 0:
                warn_msgs.append(f"{sample_label}: {group} has zero cells.")
                continue
            group_expr = imp_df.loc[group_mask, :]
            group_means = group_expr.mean(axis=0)
            group_frac = (group_expr > 0).mean(axis=0)
            for gene, value in group_means.items():
                expr_rows.append({
                    "sample": sample_label,
                    "group": group,
                    "gene": gene,
                    "mean_expr": float(value),
                    "frac_expr": float(group_frac[gene])
                })

    if warn_msgs:
        print("Warnings during cell-level aggregation:")
        for msg in warn_msgs:
            print("-", msg)

    sample_gene_presence_df = pd.DataFrame(sample_gene_presence)
    if not sample_gene_presence_df.empty:
        sample_gene_presence_df

    if len(expr_rows) == 0:
        print("No expression values available for selected leading-edge genes.")
    else:
        expr_df = pd.DataFrame(expr_rows)
        sample_order = [format_sample_label(sid) for sid in sample_ids]
        sample_group_order = (
            [f"{sample}__Myeloid 1" for sample in sample_order] +
            [f"{sample}__Myeloid 2" for sample in sample_order]
        )
        expr_df["sample_group"] = expr_df["sample"] + "__" + expr_df["group"]

        mean_mat = (
            expr_df
            .pivot_table(index="gene", columns="sample_group", values="mean_expr", aggfunc="mean")
            .reindex(index=selected_genes, columns=sample_group_order)
        )
        frac_mat = (
            expr_df
            .pivot_table(index="gene", columns="sample_group", values="frac_expr", aggfunc="mean")
            .reindex(index=selected_genes, columns=sample_group_order)
        )

        row_mean = mean_mat.mean(axis=1)
        row_std = mean_mat.std(axis=1, ddof=0).replace(0, np.nan)
        mean_z_mat = mean_mat.sub(row_mean, axis=0).div(row_std, axis=0).fillna(0)

        panel_rows = []
        set_coverage_rows = []
        for set_name, genes in set_to_genes.items():
            present_genes = [
                g for g in genes
                if g in mean_mat.index and not mean_mat.loc[g].isna().all()
            ]
            set_coverage_rows.append({
                "set_name": set_name,
                "n_leading_edge_genes": len(genes),
                "n_genes_in_plot": len(present_genes)
            })
            if len(present_genes) == 0:
                continue

            mean_part = mean_mat.loc[present_genes].copy()
            frac_part = frac_mat.loc[present_genes].copy()
            z_part = mean_z_mat.loc[present_genes].copy()
            mean_part.index.name = "gene"
            mean_part.columns.name = "sample_group"
            frac_part.index.name = "gene"
            frac_part.columns.name = "sample_group"
            z_part.index.name = "gene"
            z_part.columns.name = "sample_group"

            set_long = mean_part.stack(dropna=False).rename("mean_expr").to_frame()
            set_long = set_long.join(frac_part.stack(dropna=False).rename("frac_expr"))
            set_long = set_long.join(z_part.stack(dropna=False).rename("mean_expr_z"))
            set_long = set_long.reset_index()
            set_long[["sample", "group"]] = set_long["sample_group"].str.rsplit("__", n=1, expand=True)
            set_long["set_name"] = set_name
            panel_rows.append(set_long[["set_name", "gene", "sample", "group", "sample_group", "mean_expr", "frac_expr", "mean_expr_z"]])

        if len(panel_rows) == 0:
            print("No thematic leading-edge sets had plottable genes in cohort data.")
        else:
            leading_edge_expr_long = pd.concat(panel_rows, ignore_index=True)
            set_coverage = pd.DataFrame(set_coverage_rows)
            set_summary = (
                gsea_thematic_top[["set_name", "source", "NES", "padj", "n_leading_edge_genes"]]
                .merge(set_coverage[["set_name", "n_genes_in_plot"]], on="set_name", how="left")
                .sort_values(["padj", "NES"], ascending=[True, False])
                .reset_index(drop=True)
            )
            set_summary

            set_order = [
                s for s in gsea_thematic_top["set_name"].tolist()
                if s in set(leading_edge_expr_long["set_name"])
            ]
            n_sets = len(set_order)
            vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(leading_edge_expr_long["mean_expr_z"].to_numpy()))
            if not np.isfinite(vmax) or vmax == 0:
                vmax = 1.0

            if n_sets == 0:
                print("No thematic leading-edge sets had plottable genes in cohort data.")
            else:
                ncols = 2
                nrows = int(np.ceil(n_sets / ncols))
                fig, axes = plt.subplots(
                    nrows=nrows,
                    ncols=ncols,
                    figsize=(max(12, 0.85 * len(sample_group_order)), max(4, 2.6 * nrows + 1.2)),
                    squeeze=False
                )
                first_mesh = None

                for idx, set_name in enumerate(set_order):
                    ax = axes[idx // ncols][idx % ncols]
                    set_df = leading_edge_expr_long[leading_edge_expr_long["set_name"] == set_name].copy()
                    gene_order = [g for g in set_to_genes[set_name] if g in set_df["gene"].unique()]
                    heat_df = (
                        set_df
                        .pivot_table(index="gene", columns="sample_group", values="mean_expr_z", aggfunc="mean")
                        .reindex(index=gene_order, columns=sample_group_order)
                    )
                    sns.heatmap(
                        heat_df,
                        ax=ax,
                        cmap="vlag",
                        center=0,
                        vmin=-vmax,
                        vmax=vmax,
                        cbar=False
                    )
                    split_x = len(sample_order)
                    ax.axvline(split_x, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8)
                    ax.set_title(set_name[:75])
                    ax.set_xlabel("")
                    ax.set_ylabel("")
                    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(sample_group_order)) + 0.5)
                    ax.set_xticklabels(sample_group_order)
                    ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=45, labelsize=8)
                    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=7)
                    for label in ax.get_xticklabels():
                        label.set_ha("right")
                        label.set_rotation_mode("anchor")
                    if first_mesh is None and len(ax.collections) > 0:
                        first_mesh = ax.collections[0]

                for idx in range(n_sets, nrows * ncols):
                    axes[idx // ncols][idx % ncols].axis("off")

                if first_mesh is not None:
                    cbar = fig.colorbar(first_mesh, ax=axes.ravel().tolist(), shrink=0.65)
                    cbar.set_label("Gene-wise z-score")

                fig.suptitle(
                    "Top 10 significant ECM/glycosylation pathways\n"
                    "Leading-edge genes from Myeloid 2 > Myeloid 1, cell-level ENVI imputation",
                    y=1.02
                )
                plt.tight_layout()
                plt.show()
```

# SN Label-Transfer GSEA

```{python}
# Run the SN label-transfer branch from its dedicated folder.
sn_output_dir = pa_dir / "sn_label_transfer_gsea"
sn_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

sn_prepare_path = sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_prepare.py"

    if not p.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing SN label-transfer script: {p}")

cmd_prepare = [sys.executable, str(sn_prepare_path)]
print("Running:", " ".join(cmd_prepare))
run_prepare = subprocess.run(cmd_prepare, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(run_prepare.stdout)
if run_prepare.returncode != 0:
    print(run_prepare.stderr)
    raise RuntimeError("SN label-transfer Python prepare step failed.")

if shutil.which("Rscript") is not None:
    cmd_r = [shutil.which("Rscript"), str(sn_script_path)]
elif shutil.which("conda") is not None:
    cmd_r = ["conda", "run", "-n", "spatial", "Rscript", str(sn_script_path)]
else:

print("Running:", " ".join(cmd_r))
```

```{python}
# Expected final outputs from the SN label-transfer R stage.
sn_paths = {
    "coverage": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_coverage_summary.csv",
    "pairwise_overlap": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_pairwise_gene_overlap.csv",
    "shared_universe": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_shared_universe.csv",
    "limma_de": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_limma_de.csv",
    "genesets_filtered": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_gene_sets_filtered.csv",
    "gsea_results": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_gsea_results.csv",
    "sample_diagnostics": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_sample_diagnostics.csv",
    "transfer_diagnostics": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_py_transfer_diagnostics.csv",
    "metadata": sn_output_dir / "myeloid_sn_label_transfer_metadata.txt",
}

missing_sn = [name for name, path in sn_paths.items() if not path.exists()]
if missing_sn:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing SN label-transfer outputs: {missing_sn}")

sn_coverage = pd.read_csv(sn_paths["coverage"])
sn_pairwise_overlap = pd.read_csv(sn_paths["pairwise_overlap"])
sn_shared_universe = pd.read_csv(sn_paths["shared_universe"])
sn_limma_de = pd.read_csv(sn_paths["limma_de"])
sn_genesets_filtered = pd.read_csv(sn_paths["genesets_filtered"])
sn_gsea_results = pd.read_csv(sn_paths["gsea_results"])
sn_sample_diag = pd.read_csv(sn_paths["sample_diagnostics"])
sn_transfer_diag = pd.read_csv(sn_paths["transfer_diagnostics"])

print(f"Shared-universe size: {sn_shared_universe.shape[0]}")
print(f"DE rows: {sn_limma_de.shape[0]}")
print(f"Filtered gene sets: {sn_genesets_filtered.shape[0]}")
print(f"GSEA rows: {sn_gsea_results.shape[0]}")
```

```{python}
# Co-embedding PNGs are generated by the Python prepare step, one per sample.
coembed_dir = sn_output_dir / "coembedding"
coembed_files = sorted(coembed_dir.glob("*_coembedding_post_transfer.png"))
coembed_manifest = pd.DataFrame({
    "sample": [p.name.replace("_coembedding_post_transfer.png", "") for p in coembed_files],
    "path": [str(p) for p in coembed_files],
    "exists": [p.exists() for p in coembed_files],
})
coembed_manifest
```

```{python}
if len(coembed_files) == 0:
    print("No co-embedding PNGs found.")
else:
    n_show = min(4, len(coembed_files))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_show, 1, figsize=(12, 5 * n_show))
    if n_show == 1:
        axes = [axes]
    for ax, p in zip(axes, coembed_files[:n_show]):
        img = plt.imread(p)
        ax.imshow(img)
        ax.set_title(p.name)
        ax.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## SN Label-Transfer Top GSEA Terms

```{python}
sn_gsea_sig = sn_gsea_results[sn_gsea_results["padj"] < 0.05].copy()
if sn_gsea_sig.empty:
    print("No significant GSEA terms at FDR < 0.05.")
else:
    sn_gsea_sig["abs_nes"] = sn_gsea_sig["NES"].abs()
    sn_top_gsea = (
        sn_gsea_sig
        .sort_values(["contrast", "source", "padj", "abs_nes"], ascending=[True, True, True, False])
        .groupby(["contrast", "source"], as_index=False)
        .head(5)
        .copy()
    )
    sn_top_gsea[["contrast", "source", "set_name", "NES", "padj"]]
```

```{python}
if sn_gsea_sig.empty:
    print("Skipping GSEA plot because no significant terms were found.")
else:
    sn_gsea_plot = sn_top_gsea.copy()
    sn_gsea_plot["set_label"] = sn_gsea_plot["set_name"].str.slice(0, 65)
    plt.figure(figsize=(11, max(5, 0.25 * sn_gsea_plot.shape[0])))
    sns.scatterplot(
        data=sn_gsea_plot,
        x="NES",
        y="set_label",
        hue="source",
        style="contrast",
        size=-np.log10(np.clip(sn_gsea_plot["padj"], 1e-300, None)),
        sizes=(50, 220)
    )
    plt.axvline(0, color="gray", linewidth=1)
    plt.title("SN label-transfer top significant GSEA pathways")
    plt.xlabel("Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)")
    plt.ylabel("")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## Notes

- This notebook runs two pathways: spatial-imputation GSEA and SN label-transfer GSEA.
- All spatial-imputation outputs are written under `spatial_imputation_gsea/`.
- All SN label-transfer outputs and co-embedding PNGs are written under `sn_label_transfer_gsea/`.
- SN label-transfer candidates come from SN `annot_v1` labels: `Monocytes`, `Microglia`, and `Macrophage`.
- Hallmark pathways are included via source `H`.
